newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS raises Legato to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS raises Legato to buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities raised its rating of Legato Systems Inc to a buy from its prior rating of hold on Thursday.

-- Analyst M.K. Agarwala gave the company a new target price of $52 in a research report. The 1996 earnings per share estimate was raised to $0.53 from $0.49 and the 1997 estimate increased to $0.80 a share from $0.75.
-- Agarwala said the company's new NT product line has exceeded expectations and could continue to propel growth in the future.
